tasks.subject: Task 2: Pure release-hold helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure JVM-testable SpeakingHold + TransmitHold (~200 ms release hold).

**Files:**

- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitHoldTest.kt
